earlier.claim: A title holding square brackets writes an index entry that kmctl check cannot parse, so kmctl check fails right after kmctl new.
slug drops every non-ASCII letter instead of folding it, so 'Café état' becomes caf-tat.md.
A --description holding a newline is written as is into the section index, splitting the entry across lines.
test_new_creates_each_kind checks the file name only for decision and prototype and never checks the title value, so a misnamed practice, proposal or handoff passes row r1.

new.claim: the bracket test never checks that kmctl new succeeded or that the file is listed, so it passes when new refuses or crashes on the title
